subject: general
question: Which Indian state government has launched the **'ShramMitra'** mobile application to act as an **'Electronic Employment Exchange'** for workers and employers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• On May 20, 2026, **Haryana** Labour Minister **Anil Vij** launched the **'ShramMitra'** app in **Chandigarh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'ShramMitra'** app is designed to serve as an **'Electronic Employment Exchange'** to provide daily employment opportunities to workers and facilitate hiring for employers.
 
• The primary objective of the app is to gradually phase out the traditional **'labour chowk system'**, allowing workers to find work from their homes via mobile phones.
 
• It supports three languages: **Hindi, English, and Punjabi**, to ensure accessibility for a wide range of users.
 
• Workers can register their skills in various trades such as **mason, carpenter, electrician, plumber, gardener, painter, and welder**.
 
• The platform allows both parties to communicate directly regarding **wages, work duration, and experience**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The app was developed by the **Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board**.
 
• It is available on both **Android and Apple** platforms and is completely **free of cost**.
 
• Data for approximately **75,000 registered workers** has already been uploaded to the platform.
 
• There are currently about **135 operational labour chowks** across the state of **Haryana**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The app helps the government monitor **labour demand and supply** and assess the implementation of welfare schemes using **real-time data**.
 
• It reduces the dependence of employers on **middlemen** by providing access to verified and skilled workers.
 
• Self-employment professions like **barbers and cobblers** can also register on the platform.
